description: None of the current-unit candidate records has an opened source establishing a numerical or clearly sufficient simultaneous attendance estimate. Search-only wording includes “hundreds,” “dozens,” “a number,” and “very impressive crowd”; workforce, injury, arrest, and constituency figures are not turnout. E017 Afir Lal has an opened report saying only “a number.”
required_followup: For each candidate seek an attributed event-specific human count or a sufficiently clear qualitative estimate. Keep all unproven cases pending_threshold/pending_evidence; never infer from worker rolls, injuries, detained journalists, or association membership.

description: For 3 February palace sit-ins, Alakhbar’s previously read body describes generic workers, age-barred students, and Sheikh Ridha creditors; Al-Wiam search results list AIDS-secretariat workers, creditors and PNP nonpermanent employees. It is unresolved whether the generic worker group corresponds to either worker category and which third group assembled. Turnout is unreported.
required_followup: Read the current Al-Wiam and any separately authored eyewitness accounts under fresh gates; compare actual group identities, demands, site and counts. Preserve each group separately and do not pool simultaneous crowds.

description: Age-barred student protest leads dated 2 February at an unspecified university site, 3 February at the palace, and 10 February at the palace. Similar policy grievance does not establish same people, one campaign episode, or physical continuity.
required_followup: Compare contemporaneous originals for organizers, participants, site and recurrence. Retain distinct date/site candidates until relation and event thresholds are established.

description: ISCAE search leads mention student protests and a management meeting around 4 February, with a petition reportedly accepted. Exact event start/site, whether there was an open public assembly, its size, and whether this was a single event or multi-week dispute remain unknown.
required_followup: Open the discrete reports and establish physical assembly, site, turnout, domestic state target and whether any public sit-in/occupation continued.

description: A search-only road-maintenance result refers to the Nouakchott–Akjoujt road and is represented as two site candidates to prevent city pooling; it does not establish that separate gatherings occurred at both ends, their exact locations or common organization.
required_followup: Find event-specific reporting for each location, exact site, attendance, route action, date and relation/coordination. Do not count one road crowd at two sites without evidence.

description: Tifirit source leads report repeated actions on 6, 13, 17 and 27 February and a separate possible 7 February solidarity vigil. They do not prove uninterrupted physical presence or identify whether each date was a new gathering; the 27 February action is described at Parliament in Nouakchott rather than at the village.
required_followup: Verify each date/site from contemporaneous reports and compare organizers/participants. Do not treat campaign recurrence as physical occupation or assign February ownership to January action without onset/continuity evidence.

description: For the 6 February Tifirit action, search-only residents’ accounts allege force and injured women, while a search-only gendarmerie statement describes road reopening and alleges resistance by women. Injury reports do not give attendance; two outlet results appear to reproduce the same official account.
required_followup: Read accessible original resident and official accounts, verify origins and the event-specific scope of each claim; keep violence/response unknown until evidence supports individual variables.

description: An opened ANND monthly-report body says teachers demonstrated at the presidential palace “today Wednesday,” but the page date is 28 February and it gives no explicit event calendar date. Do not infer 24 February or merge with the separate 10 February teacher report. Its “dozens” wording does not establish the 50-person rule.
required_followup: Verify the report’s publication date/original Al-Wiam story, identify which Wednesday is meant and compare the teacher group with the 10 February event. Keep E018 start unknown meanwhile.

description: The February 22 Chami prospectors’ lead concerns a reported new tax/ore-transport fee, while the January unit’s undated prospectors’ closure candidate concerned closure of mining areas despite permits. Same place/group does not establish one event or physical continuation.
required_followup: Compare the two month files’ contemporary originals for dates, participants and grievance. Treat February 22 as a distinct action lead; do not transfer January crowd or date evidence.

description: A March retrospective says the Koylal sit-in began 22 January; a February search-only source separately describes a 22 February 10:00–14:00 sit-in. No evidence establishes continuous physical presence between those gatherings, so the February event is retained separately and the proposed continuation remains unresolved.
required_followup: Verify who attended on each date and whether there was a new gathering versus the same physical occupation; keep February event separate pending proof.

description: An English-language result broadly describes Mbagne/Ferala residents protesting land appropriation on 22 February, while the opened Arabic report identifies Afir Lal and a separate search-only French report identifies Koylal. Exact relationship among the sites/groups/actions is not established.
required_followup: Compare article text, participant identities and exact village/site before treating the reports as independent confirmation or merging Koylal and Afir Lal.

description: The 10 February teacher search excerpt uses “hundreds,” while the same-date students’ result says only “a number.” They are distinct groups at a shared reported site; neither source body is open and their crowd estimates cannot be pooled.
required_followup: Read each discrete article and establish a separate attributable turnout and physical event boundary for teachers and students.

description: Search-only headlines suggest a 24 February AIDS Secretariat sit-in and 25 February unemployed geologists’ sit-in, but the precise requested state remedy and, for geologists, Maaden’s relevant public role at the time, are not verified from the protest bodies.
required_followup: Open reports and verify specific demands, event crowd, domestic state target, employer/authority relationship and response; retain empty/provisional categories if taxonomy fit remains unclear.

description: The opened 22 February Afir Lal report says “a number” of residents objected to agricultural land grants and records dispersal, but gives no number or clear size estimate. Two journalist detentions are not protester arrests.
required_followup: Seek a participant estimate and any event-specific end, violence or protester arrest information; do not transfer counts from neighboring village reports.

description: The Koylal February result returned a tool-level Cache miss and Chami’s exact page returned “not accessible via this tool”; neither is an observed HTTP denial or body read. The AlWiam February 3 exact article has a receipt/manual preflight deferred twice for global input-hash mismatch; no body request occurred.
required_followup: Keep failed requests distinct from publisher denials. Any future request requires fresh exact-URL receipt, contemporaneous full manual publisher/origin review saved and read back, and a complete live-input hash match immediately before requesting.

description: Multiple local headlines, political statements and retrospective chronology are search-only. Tifirit official-result republications, parallel Al-Wiam/Alakhbar February 3 reporting, and Chami photo/tax articles may overlap or depend on shared sources; different URLs do not establish independent reporting.
required_followup: Compare accessible text, bylines, original agency credits and written-origin links. Do not count copied headlines/official statements as independent corroboration.

description: Searches covered Arabic, French and English, with multiple country-month, weekly, sector and locality terms. Hassaniya/local-register coverage and French/Arabic spellings beyond indexed query variants were not assessed systematically.
required_followup: Seek local-language vocabulary and regional source indexes in a later review; record any new literal queries and ordered headers before relying on them.

description: The dossier records 43 literal open-web search actions and 803 returned result headers, including a preserved two-query batched invocation. It does not reproduce systematic LexisNexis/newspaper-archive searches or establish full national coverage.
required_followup: Compare with accessible print/news archive coverage and any verified official source universe when available. Treat this as an open-web first pass, not a complete protest census.

description: For candidate events other than the explicitly reported dispersal in the Afir Lal body, most physical ends and event-specific state responses remain unknown. Reports of negotiations, planned marches, party statements, injuries or unrelated journalist detentions do not fill response variables automatically.
required_followup: Seek event-specific evidence for physical end and each of accommodation, arrests, beatings, crowd_dispersal, ignore, killings and shootings; retain unknown when absent.
